text: I paid 340 Baht just for the examination and antibiotic medication. The doctor checked the tooth and explained everything that needed to be done step by step, but didn't start the procedure immediately. We'll go back when the inflammation in the tooth subsides. He was very kind and solution-oriented. I've found my real doctor in Phuket. Thank you so much.
The doctor is lovely and has a very gentle touch.

I came for cavity treatment and a teeth cleaning, and I liked everything. The doctor was very polite. At the end of the procedure, she explained how to properly care for my teeth and gave me a small kit (a gift).
The injection was very painless because they first prepped the area (additional anesthetic).

Excellent doctor.

She gives all details explanations, doesn't tu to sell what is no needed like in other places (such as tooth replacement).

Prices are very fair compare to other dentists around.

Finally, the work was fine: problem fixed and no pain.

Always make sure to check with her before anywhere alse.

Thank you.

I developed a tooth abscess (flus) on my lower jaw and visited this clinic after checking out a few others. Even though some reviews mentioned needing an appointment in advance, they took me in right away. The doctor examined me, took an X-ray, and prescribed antibiotics. They scheduled me for a tooth extraction this Saturday.

The staff was very welcoming, and the doctors were kind. The consultation, X-ray, and medication cost only 500 THB total. Now I’m just waiting for Saturday!
